info.description: Public HTTP API exposed by the Book Store API Gateway.
info.title: Book Store API

post.description: Creates a book. The bearer token must contain the admin role.

put.description: Updates a book. The bearer token must contain the admin role.

delete.description: Deletes a book. The bearer token must contain the admin role.

get.description: Returns user profiles using cursor pagination. The bearer token must contain the admin role.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous request
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Returns one user profile by ID. The bearer token must contain the admin role.

put.description: Updates a customer's display name. The bearer token must contain the admin role.

delete.description: Deletes the auth account transactionally and queues asynchronous profile deletion through the outbox. The bearer token must contain the admin role.

put.description: Administrative funding/testing endpoint. It never directly overwrites the stored balance.
put.summary: Adjust a wallet balance through double-entry ledger records

post.description: Validates a Facebook user access token against the configured Meta app. Storefront clients may request account creation; admin clients should only sign in existing accounts.
Verifies a Google Identity Services ID token. Storefront clients may request account creation; admin clients should only sign in existing accounts.
Authenticates an account and returns a bearer access token.
Revokes the current refresh session and clears its HttpOnly cookie.
Issues a short-lived state value and matching HttpOnly cookie for Google or Facebook login CSRF protection.
Rotates the HttpOnly refresh cookie and returns a new short-lived access token.
Creates an auth account and schedules profile creation through the transactional outbox.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of books.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous request
parameters.name: cursor

post.summary: Add a book to the current cart

post.description: POST /batch-delete is preferred because some proxies do not reliably forward DELETE request bodies.

post.summary: Create an order from the current cart and reserve stock

put.summary: Cancel an unpaid order and release reserved stock

get.summary: Get the current-user payment for an order

get.description: Public server-to-server endpoint. Signature, merchant reference and amount are verified before state changes.
Returns the profile associated with the bearer token.

put.description: Updates the display name of the profile associated with the bearer token.

get.description: Returns the current health status of the HTTP gateway.

BearerAuth.description: Enter the token using the format: Bearer {token}
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
